headline: TTM Technologies shares drop over 25% following market open
summary: Shares of TTM Technologies opened down 18% before extending losses beyond 25% during afternoon trading, triggering pending shareholder investigations.
why: TTM Technologies manufactures specialized electronic components and printed circuit boards.

impacts.name: TTM Technologies Inc.
impacts.why: A rapid market selloff reduced the technology manufacturer's equity capital value.

why_moved: Aggressive intraday selling drove TTM Technologies stock down by over 25%.
